name: Jungo Connectivity Ltd
summary: Jungo Connectivity Ltd specializes in artificial intelligence software engineered for in-cabin sensing applications. Their product lineup includes CoDriver, a camera-based driver monitoring system, and VuDrive, another solution for driver monitoring. For human sensing capabilities, they offer the MagiaTouch SDK. The company also provides various device driver development tools: WinDriver, which supports USB, PCI, and PCI Express, and DriverCore for PC USB drivers. Additionally, MediaCore delivers infotainment multimedia and connectivity middleware. Beyond these software products, Jungo offers bespoke development services for USB, PCI, and PCIe device drivers, catering to critical sectors such as medical, industrial, and defense. They also assist with Windows certification program submissions and code signing certifications. Established in 1998 in Netanya, Israel, Jungo Connectivity Ltd operated as KRFTech Ltd until its name change in March 2000 and was previously a subsidiary of Cisco Systems, Inc.
